ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the CAMS Cloud ticket was ingested into the raw-data store

affected_systems.description: Ground segment systems affected by the anomaly (Jira affected-systems custom field)

addressed_entities.description: Entities addressed by the ticket (Jira addressed-entities custom field)

assigned_element.description: Element(s) the ticket is assigned to (Jira assigned-element custom field)

created.description: Date the CAMS ticket was created in Jira

criticality.description: Criticality level of the anomaly (Jira criticality custom field)

entity.description: Primary entity responsible for the ticket (Jira entity custom field)

environment.description: Environment description of the ticket (Jira environment field)

esa_group.description: ESA group associated with the ticket (Jira ESA-group custom field)

involved_entities.description: Entities involved in the ticket (Jira involved-entities custom field)

key.description: Jira issue key uniquely identifying the CAMS ticket

linked_issues.description: Keys of Jira issues linked to this ticket (inward issue links)

occurence_date.description: Date the anomaly occurred (Jira occurrence-date custom field)

originating_entity.description: Entity that originated the ticket (Jira originating-entity custom field)

reporter.description: Display name of the Jira user who reported the ticket

review_board_dispositions.description: Review board dispositions recorded on the ticket (Jira custom field)

status.description: Current workflow status of the Jira ticket

title.description: Ticket title taken from the Jira issue summary

updated.description: Date the CAMS ticket was last updated in Jira

urgency.description: Urgency level of the anomaly (Jira urgency custom field)

reportName.description: Jira REST self URL of the source issue

reportFolder.description: Source folder of the ingested report

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced the record (Jira_CAMS_Cloud_Tickets)
